leads.subject: Andrei Iosivas
leads.text: ESPN reports Bengals receiver Andrei Iosivas will miss four to six weeks and go on injured reserve after surgery to repair a torn ligament in his thumb, suffered in the Week 2 win over Houston; ESPN adds it is unclear when in the game it happened.
leads.verifyNext: Bengals.com press-conference coverage or an NFL.com sentence naming the moment; the league's Sept 23 roundup reports only the IR move ("torn ligament in his thumb") and never places it in the game.
leads.notes: Cincinnati has no archived incident at all. ESPN's own text says his final play was in punt coverage, i.e. he was never ruled out during the game, so even a club confirmation may belong in the archive as an unconfirmed outcome rather than an out/did-not-return row.
